# TASK-002 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `4efcf9c2f5437f01fdc960761113265396e468f3031567b8d4790f57a7d7f314`

## Required Rules
- `runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-skill-001`: Skills must honor system/public/private layering, require explicit activation/policy gates before tools run, emit progress/telemetry without secrets, and respect concurrency/lease limits.
  - rule_sha256=039218a3e9b680320eeff842363b1b83913a25da06a1670cd68db938e4d20db4 verifier=runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-skill-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-skill-layering-001`: Resolution order prefers system (`system_protected`) over public/private; public/private name conflicts must not silently overwrite—override only via explicit allow_override policy.
  - rule_sha256=e1d142969bb59f32871b956bdad41a8c8df13a8ab556a432aa0fd7f71db48b1d verifier=runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-skill-layering-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-log-injection-001`: Tool/plugin modules must receive logging via an injected `log` callback (default no-op) instead of scattered `console.*`; the openclaw plugin path injects `api.logger?.warn`, the CLI path injects `console.warn`.
  - rule_sha256=8102b528b4a0f6b06a0e1077bd6c82b9d7b31a69d5265f2c7afd9a7ade9b3819 verifier=runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-log-injection-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-log-prefix-001`: Log lines must carry a stable module prefix (`[session-manager]`, `[muad-runtime-guard]`) with `[<module>-<action>]` sub-tags for grep-ability.
  - rule_sha256=84b4b9c18f1f42a2cecaa2387092bf8baf24869019e2428d2718d9c97a82c666 verifier=runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-log-prefix-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-skill-fail-loud-001`: Skill scripts must report failures to stderr and exit non-zero (fail loud); stdout is reserved for the machine-readable result. Errors written to stdout break exec-failure log forwarding.
  - rule_sha256=b0860aedc9c0022936eec559fe27a75ad510e768b8b597e2ce0169c0d9a26414 verifier=runtime-skill-execution#RULE-runtime-skill-fail-loud-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
